decision_rule: Unit = one final world with both arms. A criterion PASSES iff it passes on every final world (3 of 3). 'one mission produces 2S, 2T and 2E beliefs': in both arms every domain has DIRECT revisions, all with consumed evidence, some belief revised in place (max revision > 0), and no revision of another run in the store. 'Model1 reasons across all three via the Belief Bus': in both arms at least one EGDC decision's claim graph cites beliefs owned by SPATIAL, TECHNICAL and ECOLOGICAL (owner = bus head domain), no cited (belief, revision) is missing from the committed revisions, the query engine used query_model2s/2t/2e, every sensing-gate record cites claims and beliefs of all three domains, and the gate verdict agrees with the Twin2E truth verdict (true visibility at the true target) on at least 80 % of the gate records; TURBID has at least one DEFERRED_LOW_VISIBILITY, CLEAR has none and at least one PROCEED. 'children remain authoritative within domains': in both arms zero bus rejections, every bus head is a revision its own child committed (the bus may lag the child, never lead or replace it), every revision's provenance root comes from its own domain package, no DIRECT revision consumed evidence of another domain's sensors (and none unresolved), cross-domain deliveries exist and are all CROSS_DOMAIN_CONTEXT, CONTEXT revisions consume no evidence, and a bus loaded with the mission's heads rejects every foreign-domain write with its heads unchanged.
